title: kithd: config from env vars
description: Create kithd::config module with Config struct parsed from env vars. Each field maps to a KITHD_* env var with documented defaults. db_path, cert_path, key_path are derived from data_dir. No panics in from_env(); log warnings for invalid values and use defaults. Keep KITH_DB_PATH and KITH_OWNER_ID as silent fallbacks for backward compat during transition.
